text: N54 NEWS: Arasaka denies 'unscheduled data anomaly' at downtown substation. Stock dips 2%.
NCPD MAX-TAC responds to cyberpsycho incident in Watson; three confirmed flatlined.
Militech announces new black-ICE contract; netrunner deaths 'within acceptable parameters.'
Trauma Team raises platinum-tier rates again. Combat zone residents 'unbothered, mostly dead.'
Weather: acid drizzle through the night, clearing to smog by morning. Wear the rebreather.
Edgerunner legend rumored planning 'one last score.' Fixers told to keep their mouths shut.
Nomad convoy clashes with Raffen Shiv on the Badlands route; eddies and blood on the asphalt.
New braindance drops tonight in Japantown. Critics call it 'too real to be legal.'
City Council reaffirms it has 'full control' of the combat zone. Nobody in the zone agrees.
Black market chrome prices spike; ripperdocs report a run on Sandevistans.
N54 NIGHTWIRE: Anonymous leak claims Arasaka pensioner IDs are still signing internal memos.
City coroner reports a 17% rise in 'death by incompatible memory.' Officials blame bad braindances.
Militech denies buying predictive casualty lists. Analysts note denial was issued three hours before the accusation.
Watson residents report hearing loved ones on emergency channels. NCPD advises citizens not to respond.
Afterlife odds board updates: unnamed crew now 80-to-1 to survive an Arasaka tower run. Bets remain open.
